initial_harness_failure: Browser integration inherited the unit fixture that disables controls.stopped; explicit real-control restoration is now part of every plan browser case.
product_failure: With real controls enabled, durable stop denied the provider request but the native runner classified the typed admission denial as failed rather than cancelled.
fix: Introduce DurableStopError as a RequestBudgetError subtype. Native failure finalization maps this type to cancellation with Stopped as requested.; ordinary budget/provider failures retain failed status and traceback. No text matching determines cancellation.
scenario: Real browser-originated approval and stop requests through Next proxies/native engine/private canonical PostgreSQL. Pause admission immediately after the durable claim, observe accepted, persist stop, observe stopping, then release admission. The execution audit becomes cancelled; exactly zero execution provider calls and zero business-tool calls occur. Preparation retains its two draft provider calls and alignment check.
checks: Ruff lint/format, Node syntax and diff checks pass; no size cap increased.
limits: The early-stop requests use browser fetch/API requests, not a dedicated Stop-button rendering assertion. The gate simulates delayed admission, not process death/restart. This covers ordinary native plan approval; deep-engine classification and orphaned approval recovery remain unverified. No production deployment or full acceptance claim.
